pages.heading: Welcome
pages.body:
This is a zine. It is eight small pages printed on one sheet of paper, folded and cut so the pages read in order.

Use the arrows in Read to flip through it.

pages.heading: Make it yours
pages.body: Everything here is editable. Click a page on the left, then type. Your work saves itself as you go.

pages.heading: Add things
pages.body: Use the rail on the right to add an image, a text box, or an icon. Icons are drawn in, so they stay crisp at any size.

pages.heading: Style it
pages.body: Select text to make it bold, italic, or a new color. Select an icon to recolor it. The theme sets the paper and ink.

pages.heading: A text box
pages.body: Text boxes float anywhere on the page. Drag them, resize them, rotate them. This little note is one:

textBoxes.html: Make a mess. Clean it up later.

pages.heading: Watch the space
pages.body: Each page has a soft budget. The bar under the canvas fills as you write, so your words fit the paper when you print.

pages.heading: Print it
pages.body: The Print tab shows the sheet: which page lands where, and how it folds. Print at 100%, fold, cut, and you have a zine.

pages.heading: Now go
pages.body:
That is the whole thing. Start a new zine, or open this one and bend it into something of your own.

-- Zine Forge
